{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.919
    | text      = I think, I think incorporating that in clown business, that could be trouble.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = You are now a technocrat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.000
    | text      = I'm a policy wonk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.000
    | text      = Four stars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.000
    | text      = Go home to your mother and tell her you're brilliant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:51.080
    | text      = Someone, someone sodomite sent me a bucket of poop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.600
    | text      = Daddy shark.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.600
    | text      = Bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.980
    | text      = Jar Jar Binks has a Caribbean black accent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.440
    | text      = He's a loser.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.440
    | text      = Little, little titty baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.399
    | text      = I don't want to hate black people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.039
    | text      = I renounce Jesus Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.840
    | text      = Thank you so much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.840
    | text      = Thank you very much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:08.840
    | text      = So, Jordan, I'm back from the road and all that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.720
    | text      = You are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.720
    | text      = And we're adjusting back into normal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:14.759
    | text      = And there's a lot of stuff going on over at Infowars and we're going to get into some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.919
    | text      = of that stuff on Monday.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.320
    | text      = But today I wanted to ruminate on something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:24.759
    | text      = And before, just as a little bit of an introduction, I'm going to play you this clip of Alex from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.559
    | text      = 2005.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:30.559
    | text      = Alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.559
    | text      = Yeah, this is about survival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.440
    | text      = One thing holding us back is so many so-called alternative truth leaders or patriots are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.879
    | text      = just complete psychopathic power trip individuals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.159
    | text      = I mean, they, you see in the public events, they get off on crowds.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.879
    | text      = They get off on being told how great they are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.679
    | text      = And I think there's something wrong with somebody that really gets off on that and likes that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.519
    | text      = And that's what they're hungry for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.779
    | text      = That's what they're looking for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.879
    | text      = We're not doing that, folks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:53.879
    | text      = We are truly disgusted by what's happening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.360
    | text      = So on Wednesday night, Trump asked all the major networks to let him break into their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.399
    | text      = normal programming to address the country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.559
    | text      = And it was one of the most bleak pictures I've seen in a very long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.000
    | text      = For one thing, it interrupted Survivor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.940
    | text      = And I finally kind of made peace with the new season.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:12.620
    | text      = So it was a bit of a setback for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:15.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.120
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.120
    | text      = That's why it ended up being a bright spot again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:18.120
    | text      = Woof.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:19.120
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:20.120
    | text      = But it was also disgusting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:21.120
    | text      = I feel like I keep getting tricked by these Trump speeches where there's some buzz and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:23.320
    | text      = anticipation around it, where everyone convinces themselves that he's going to say something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:27.159
    | text      = important and then it just falls flat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:30.059
    | text      = He didn't say anything that mattered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.539
    | text      = There was no clarity that was provided about the war in Iran.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:34.580
    | text      = I feel like I know less after watching him talk because he's such an obvious liar that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.299
    | text      = hearing him talk just gives you new things to doubt.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:42.940
    | text      = Past leaders were orators who gave speeches that calmed a country when times were tense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:47.139
    | text      = And it's remarkable how Trump is really the opposite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:49.980
    | text      = Everything could be going well and hearing him speak would make me feel off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.879
    | text      = But the reason that I'm saying that it was disgusting was because a lot of the speech
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.019
    | text      = was dedicated to talking about how he's killed so many people in Iran.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:01.860
    | text      = A lot of it centered around bragging about killing Iranian government officials, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.019
    | text      = the reality is what he actually was talking about involves a ton of civilian death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.299
    | text      = And seeing him talk about it in such a brazen, flippant way, it felt like it trivialized
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:16.620
    | text      = life itself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:18.419
    | text      = I was feeling really put off, and as I explored that feeling, it dawned on me that this type
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:22.980
    | text      = of shit isn't as uncommon as how it made me feel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:26.500
    | text      = Bush bragged about his acts of war back when he was president.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.700
    | text      = Hillary Clinton famously said, we came, we saw, he died, about the Obama administration's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.220
    | text      = attacks on Libya.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.980
    | text      = My feeling came from a place where I like to imagine that our administration, like the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.200
    | text      = leaders, are generally circumspect about killing, and talking about our wars as if they didn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.100
    | text      = actually want to do them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:47.179
    | text      = I like to imagine that our leaders dislike the idea of international conflicts, but it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:52.220
    | text      = inevitable and some people are going to get killed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.139
    | text      = But Trump doesn't let you think that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:57.460
    | text      = It's super clear that he's proud of dropping bombs, and he loves threatening to drop more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:03.179
    | text      = He was talking about how if Iran doesn't do what he wants, he's going to take them back
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:07.299
    | text      = to the Stone Age.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:09.379
    | text      = It's fucked up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:10.899
    | text      = Obviously, I don't mean to say here that both sides are equally bad or anything like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.139
    | text      = Just that this overt bloodlust that Trump was displaying wasn't as unfamiliar as my
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:20.580
    | text      = revulsion wanted it to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.940
    | text      = These thoughts sent me into a contemplative depression, and I could barely enjoy the rest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:28.019
    | text      = of Survivor when he came back on after Trump's speech.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.220
    | text      = In Survivor, there are a number of traditional paths to victory, and one of the most time
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:36.659
    | text      = tested is becoming friends with the worst, least charismatic person out there, and trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:41.700
    | text      = to get to the end with them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.639
    | text      = If you vote together, that doubles your influence, and if you make it to the jury, make it to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:48.039
    | text      = the point where they're deciding the game, no one's going to vote for that other person
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:51.720
    | text      = because they're the loser that you just dragged to the end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:54.080
    | text      = You only have to be faster than the other person running against the bear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:56.840
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:57.840
    | text      = That's a great strategy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.120
    | text      = That strategy has fallen out of favor in modern times because savvy players can see it developing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.360
    | text      = fairly early, and they nip it in the bud.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:07.360
    | text      = Now in season 50, there's no real losers that could just fit into that role.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:12.639
    | text      = Some people are more liked than others, but there's no real mopes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:16.580
    | text      = No one's just around as someone who's going to get played because they're stupid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.539
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:23.539
    | text      = It's just not going to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.539
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.539
    | text      = As I was thinking about this and Survivor, it made me think about a recent thing that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.580
    | text      = Trump said in a speech that he gave at the Future Investment Initiative.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.379
    | text      = Mr. President, what is the one leadership trait the world is missing right now?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.059
    | text      = What is missing in leadership?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:45.059
    | text      = Well, it's winning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.539
    | text      = You got to win.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.539
    | text      = You know, I've watched a lot of people, leaders, great leaders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:51.659
    | text      = And you know, the one thing about sports is you break it down into, you know, a two hour
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.820
    | text      = period, something nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:57.179
    | text      = You don't have to wait a lifetime to find out if somebody, a winner or a loser, you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:00.500
    | text      = got a lot of losers, mostly losers, fortunately.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.700
    | text      = It's a good thing to have a lot of losers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:05.420
    | text      = I always like to hang around with losers, actually, because it makes me feel better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:09.500
    | text      = Oh, my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:10.500
    | text      = I hate guys that are very, very successful and you have to listen to their success stories.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:15.059
    | text      = I like people that like to listen to my success.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.579
    | text      = But I find and I found this and I'm only kidding.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:23.940
    | text      = I want to say that sort of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:26.500
    | text      = I'm only kidding.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:27.500
    | text      = But I'm not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.779
    | text      = So Trump has said a lot of crazy shit in the past few weeks and a lot of it we really haven't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:33.339
    | text      = touched on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.339
    | text      = But this was something that I felt needed its own moment because it directly intersects
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:38.859
    | text      = with Alex in a devastating way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.819
    | text      = Prior to teaming up with Trump, Alex was able to maintain his support for capitalism
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:45.660
    | text      = by insisting that there was good capitalism and bad capitalism, which was secretly just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.220
    | text      = communism wearing a wig.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:52.259
    | text      = The good capitalism was the real capitalism that wanted everyone to succeed because a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:57.019
    | text      = rising tide, it lifts all boats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:59.940
    | text      = And the bad capitalism was the kind that was predicated on a smaller group of people succeeding
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:05.140
    | text      = and placing themselves apart from the rest of us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:08.299
    | text      = But then Trump came along and Alex had a serious problem on his hands.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:13.579
    | text      = Trump represented all of the characteristics of bad capitalism in the way that Alex preached
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.220
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:19.220
    | text      = Trump put his name on all of his buildings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.779
    | text      = He lived a lifestyle that flaunted his affluence in people's face.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.460
    | text      = And he had a long running TV show where his catchphrase was, you're fired.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:28.680
    | text      = He was the avatar of wealth exclusion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.859
    | text      = He was super rich and he wanted to make sure you knew it.
}}
